jobs.title: Chief Operating Officer
jobs.description:
New York, New York Category Operations Job Id P\-100170 Job Type Full Time $165,000\-$200,000/annual
  
**Job Requirements**  

The Chief Operating Officer (COO) is accountable for all operational, financial, and administrative functions across the Company's global security, investigations, and consulting divisions. The COO serves as a key strategic partner to the CEO and Chairman, ensuring the Company's operations, infrastructure, and capabilities remain best\-in\-class and aligned with its long\-term vision.

  

**Responsibilities**


* Provide direct oversight of all global business units, ensuring alignment with corporate strategy, and execution of same through identified performance objectives.
* Drive business development efforts, including cultivating new client relationships and expanding existing accounts, by identifying new opportunities.
* Ensure the Company’s operational infrastructure, systems, and capabilities remain modern, scalable, and aligned with its strategic vision.
* Directly oversee the General Manager, Controller, and Director of Administration; ensure effective leadership across all functional areas and maintain regular reporting to the CEO on key developments and risks.
* Establish, monitor, and enforce quality control standards and performance metrics across the organization.
* Lead organizational performance management, including supervision structures, training programs, and continuous evaluation of personnel and business unit effectiveness.
  

**Financial Oversight**


* Oversee the Controller and maintain full accountability for the Company’s financial management and health.
* Ensure adherence to GAAP standards and compliance with all regulatory, tax, licensing, and client\-specific financial requirements.
* Ensure compliance with all tax and regulatory filings, and all finance deliverables and obligations.
* Monitor and manage profitability drivers and closely manage overtime (OT) and lost hours across profit centers, ensuring alignment with budget targets.
* Maintain real\-time awareness of key financial indicators and provide ongoing briefings to the CEO and Chairman.
* Ensure timely and accurate completion of all financial audits.
* Ensure that Controller briefs the Chairman and CEO weekly finance meetings and maintain readiness to report on financial performance at any time.
  

**Administrative \& Organizational Leadership**


* Oversee the Director of Administration and all administrative functions, including Human Resources, recruiting, compliance, and support services.
* Implement data\-driven, metrics\-based management practices to improve efficiency and effectiveness across administrative functions.
* Stay current on industry trends and best practices; lead the evaluation and integration of AI and other innovative technologies into Company operations.
* Oversee compliance with HR, licensing, insurance, and regulatory requirements.
* Define and drive organizational strategy, workforce planning, and hiring initiatives.
* Maintain authority over hiring, promotion, and termination decisions for management and staff roles.
* Collaborate with CEO and Director of Administration on RFP responses and negotiate contract terms to ensure commercially sound and profitable client and vendor agreements.
  

  

**Operational Leadership**


* Oversee the General Manager and continuously assess operational programs, policies, and procedures to identify efficiencies and implement improvements across all business units, and all business regions.
* Ensure client satisfaction across all engagements, maintaining accountability for client relationships and points of contact.
* Partner with the CEO and GM to establish strong client communication frameworks and proactively address client needs.
* Travel as required to support client engagements and organizational priorities.
* Manage relationships with teaming partners and joint ventures, ensuring appropriate operational, financial, and administrative controls are in place.
* Dedicate full professional effort, attention, and leadership to advancing the Company’s mission and interests.
  

**Core Competencies \& Expectations**


* Demonstrated leadership with integrity, accountability, and sound judgment
* Advanced understanding of business planning, operations, and regulatory environments
* Strong command of GAAP and financial management principles
* Proven ability to implement data analytics, KPIs, and performance metrics
* Decisive problem\-solving skills with the ability to anticipate and mitigate risk
* Proactive, hands\-on leadership style with a focus on motivation, continuous improvement, and organizational effectiveness
  

  

  

  

  

**Work Experience**  

* Bachelor’s Degree in criminal justice, business management or a related field
* Minimum of 10 years of Executive Managerial experience in the private sector
* Executive\-level experience leading complex, multi\-functional operations, preferably within security, investigations, consulting, professional services, or similarly regulated environments.
* Proven record of translating strategic objectives into disciplined operational plans, measurable performance goals, and scalable business processes.
* Strong financial acumen, including experience with budgeting, forecasting, profitability management, audit readiness, GAAP compliance, and executive\-level financial reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to lead senior managers and cross\-functional teams, establish accountability, and build high\-performing organizational structures.
* Proficiency in using data, KPIs, operational dashboards, and performance metrics to drive decision\-making, efficiency, risk mitigation, and continuous improvement.
* Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to brief ownership, the CEO, senior leadership, clients, and external stakeholders on operational, financial, and organizational matters.

jobs.description:
Senior Broadband ISP Program Director – Municipal Fiber Network

About Golden Tech and Services

Golden Tech and Services, LLC is a New York State\- and New York City\-certified Minority\-Owned Business Enterprise providing cybersecurity, cloud, information technology, consulting, and professional training services.

We are recruiting an experienced Senior Broadband ISP Program Director for an anticipated public\-sector broadband engagement involving a county\-owned fiber\-optic network.

This is an individual, contract\-contingent position. It is not a solicitation for companies, vendors, or business proposals. Employment or engagement will depend on contract award, final project requirements, verification of qualifications, and execution of an appropriate individual employment or consulting agreement.

Position Summary

The Senior Broadband ISP Program Director will provide technical, operational, regulatory, and program leadership for a potential municipal broadband initiative.

The anticipated network includes approximately 113 miles of county\-owned fiber, six central\-office locations, a 100 Gbps core ring, XPoN infrastructure, fixed\-wireless components, and residential, commercial, institutional, and government subscribers.

The selected professional should have substantial experience planning, launching, operating, or overseeing municipal, utility, open\-access, or commercial ISP networks.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead planning and implementation of a municipal broadband and ISP operations program.
* Coordinate the integration of a 100 Gbps core network with XPoN, middle\-mile, last\-mile, fixed\-wireless, and carrier\-interconnection infrastructure.

* Participate in regular project meetings and government\-agency calls.

* Develop strategies for affordable broadband, low\-income service options, customer acquisition, community outreach, and subscriber retention.
* Assist with operating budgets, revenue projections, subscriber take\-rate assumptions, maintenance costs, and revenue\-sharing models.
* Help evaluate pole attachments, dark\-fiber access, interconnection arrangements, carrier hotels, wholesale services, fiber leases, and indefeasible rights of use.

* At least 10 years of progressively responsible experience in broadband, telecommunications, ISP operations, or fiber\-network management.

* Experience with high\-capacity core networks, including 100 Gbps architecture or comparable carrier\-grade environments.
* Knowledge of ISP network operations, service activation, monitoring, maintenance, outage response, customer support, and billing processes.
* Understanding of New York telecommunications requirements, including Certificates of Public Convenience and Necessity, tariffs, and Public Service Commission requirements.
* Experience coordinating central\-office equipment, carrier interconnections, customer\-premises equipment, and network electronics.
* Experience managing multidisciplinary teams involving engineers, field technicians, construction contractors, vendors, government officials, and community stakeholders.
* Experience preparing technical plans, budgets, schedules, performance reports, and executive\-level presentations.
* Strong knowledge of network security, operational resilience, incident response, business continuity, and disaster recovery.
* Ability to document comparable public\-sector or municipal broadband projects and provide professional references.
* Strong written, verbal, analytical, organizational, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Authorization to work in the United States.

jobs.title: Director of Philanthropy, Sr.
jobs.description:
**THE BROWN** \| The Cici and Hyatt Brown Museum of Art, Science \& History

**Position Description:** SENIOR DIRECTOR OF PHILANTHROPY

**Reports To**: Chief Executive Officer, direct line. Dotted line to the Chief Operating Officer in partnership with the Executive Assistant, who provide shared administrative and cross\-departmental support.

**Classification:** Exempt, full\-time Director (Departmental) tier; individual contributor, no direct reports

**Department:** Philanthropy \- owns all institutional fundraising revenue

**Position Summary**

The Senior Director of Philanthropy is the Museum's senior fundraising executive, holding full accountability for every philanthropic revenue line: individual and major gifts, corporate and foundation partnerships, membership giving, special event fundraising, planned giving, and the annual fund. This is not a single\-program role \- it is ownership of the institution's entire philanthropy portfolio. The position reports directly to the Chief Executive Officer and operates as a senior individual contributor, personally building donor and funder relationships and executing strategy rather than managing a team. The role inherits and builds on the fundraising infrastructure, donor data, and three\-year development plan established during the Museum's transition period, and is expected to take full ownership of that foundation rather than start from a blank slate.

**Tier Classification**

This position sits within the Director (Departmental) tier rather than the Director (Operational) tier. The distinction is structural, not titular: Departmental\-tier roles carry a direct CEO or Board\-facing reporting line, full accountability for a revenue\-generating or mission\-critical function, and strategic rather than single\-function scope. The Senior Director of Philanthropy meets this standard through its direct CEO reporting line, Board\-facing fundraising accountability, and ownership of every revenue stream in the department, even though the role currently carries no direct reports.

**Organizational Hierarchy**

* Reports directly to the Chief Executive Officer for strategy, revenue accountability, and Board facing philanthropy matters.
* Works closely with the Chief Operating Officer, who coordinates shared support resources across departments, including design, marketing, events, and the institution's data/database function.
* Partners with the Executive Assistant, who provides embedded scheduling and donor\-communication support to this role.
* Holds no direct reports. During the transition period, receives operational support from the Development Specialist and, once hired, the Database Administrator \- both shared institutional resources rather than reports into this position.

**Scope of Responsibility**

This role owns every philanthropic revenue line at the institution. Programs and campaigns will change over time; the categories below are intended to stay accurate regardless of how any individual program is named or restructured.

* **Individual \& Major Giving:** cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship of individual donors at every level, from annual fund contributors through principal and major gift prospects.
* **Corporate \& Foundation Partnerships**: cultivation and stewardship of corporate sponsors and funders across all institutional programs and campaigns, not limited to any single event. Includes strategy and pipeline management for foundation and government grant funding, in coordination with contracted grant writing support where applicable.
* **Membership Giving:** strategy, cultivation, and growth of the Museum's principal giving membership tier and its broader membership program.
* **Special Event Fundraising**: revenue strategy and accountability for the Museum's signature fundraising events, including sponsorship, procurement, and net revenue performance.
* **Planned \& Legacy Giving**: cultivation of the planned giving pipeline and stewardship of legacy commitments.
* **Annual Fund**: strategy and execution of the Museum's core annual giving program.
* **Campaign Support:** donor relations and stewardship in support of active capital campaigns, in coordination with the Chief Executive Officer and any contracted campaign counsel.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute an annual philanthropy plan with defined revenue targets across every giving category above, in partnership with the CEO.
* Personally manage a portfolio of donors and funders spanning individual, corporate, and foundation relationships, including direct cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship.
* Own sponsorship strategy for all institutional programs and events, not limited to any single campaign, including direct outreach to corporate partners.
* Direct the Museum's grant strategy and pipeline across foundation and government sources, coordinating with contracted grant writing support on proposal development, submission, and compliance reporting.
* Lead the Museum's signature fundraising events, including sponsorship sales, procurement, budget management, and post\-event stewardship.
* Grow the Museum's membership giving program through structured cultivation, benefit fulfillment, and retention strategy.
* Establish and maintain a donor relations and stewardship system spanning all revenue lines, including gift acknowledgment standards, recognition, and planned giving cultivation.
* Assume ownership of the fundraising systems, donor data, and three\-year development plan established prior to this hire, refining and building on that foundation rather than rebuilding it.
* Provide philanthropy counsel and support to the President and CEO and the Board of Trustees.
* Report progress against revenue targets, across every giving category, to the President and CEO on a regular basis.
* Coordinate with the Chief Operating Officer to access shared design, marketing, data, and administrative support as needed.

**Success Measures**

**About Us**

The Palestinian American Medical Association (PAMA) is a U.S.\-registered 501(c)(3\) nonprofit organization established in 2013 by Palestinian\-American healthcare professionals. Our Washington, D.C. headquarters leads strategic fundraising, donor relations, and advocacy, while our country office in Palestine manages on\-the\-ground program implementation.

PAMA addresses critical healthcare needs in Palestine through targeted medical assistance, humanitarian aid, and medical education initiatives. Our core programs in Healthcare, Education, and Livelihood focus on enhancing healthcare capacity, supporting medical professionals, and fostering long\-term community resilience. Joining PAMA means contributing to a mission\-driven organization dedicated to improving lives through sustainable healthcare solutions.

**Position Summary**

The Director of Development is a senior member of PAMA’s leadership team, responsible for driving institutional and individual fundraising strategy, expanding PAMA’s donor base in key growth markets, and building the infrastructure to support a growing development operation. jobs.title: Executive Director - NONPROFIT
jobs.description:
**JOB OVERVIEW**

Expected hours per week: 30\.

Reporting to the Board of Directors, the Executive Director (ED) is the chief executive of our nonprofit organization, **TeamUp! With Families, Inc.** (TU), and the key leader of its medical equipment lending library, **Katy's Kloset**. The ED will have overall strategic and operational responsibility for the execution and growth of the mission as well as overseeing fundraising, staff members, volunteers, programs, and sponsored family activities. The ED will develop deep knowledge of the field, core programs, operations, and business plans.

**OUR MISSION**

Our volunteer driven organization provides unique family\-centered activities that are physically inclusive and fun. Our medical equipment lending library, Katy’s Kloset, accepts and distributes donated durable medical equipment and supplies to adults and children at no or low cost.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Leadership \& Management:**

· Ensure ongoing local programmatic excellence, rigorous program evaluation, and consistent quality of finance and administration, fundraising, communications, and systems; recommend timelines and resources needed to achieve annual and long\-term strategic goals.

· Actively engage and energize TU employees, volunteers, board members, event committees, alumni, partnering organizations, and funders.

· Develop, maintain, and support a strong board of directors; serve as ex\-officio of each committee; seek and build board involvement with strategic direction for both ongoing local operations.

· Lead, coach, develop, recruit and retain TU's high\-performance employees and volunteer teams, as well as develop and maintain a climate which attracts, keeps, and motivates a diverse staff of top quality people.

· A willingness to learn, actively participate and identify the needs and opportunities of the organization.

· Ensure effective systems to track scaling progress and regularly evaluate program components, so as to measure successes that can be effectively communicated to the board, donors, and other constituents.

**Fundraising \& Communications:**

* Expand local revenue streams and fundraising activities to financially sustain and support existing program operations and regional expansion.
* Deepen and refine all aspects of communications—from social media presence to external relations \-\- with the goal of creating a stronger brand.
* Cultivate relationships with potential funders as well as maintain current development connections. Use external presence and relationships to garner new opportunities.

**Planning \& New Business:**

* Build partnerships as well as nurture established relationships with business and community impact leaders.
* Be an external local presence that publishes and communicates program results with an emphasis on the successes of the local program.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

The ED will be thoroughly committed to the mission of Team Up! With Families, Inc. All candidates should have a proven track record of leadership, fundraising, coaching, and relationship management experience.

**Specific Requirements Include**:

* Bachelor’s degree preferred with at least 5 years of senior management experience; track record of effectively leading fundraising and scaling a performance\- and outcomes\-based organization and staff; ability to point to specific examples of having developed and implemented strategies that have taken an organization to the next stage of growth.
* Unwavering commitment to quality programs and data\-driven program evaluation.
* Excellence in organizational management and proven ability to recruit, train and coach staff and volunteers; manage and develop high\-performance teams, communicate and achieve strategic objectives, and manage a budget.
* Past success working with a board of directors with the ability to cultivate existing and future board member relationships.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; a persuasive and passionate communicator with excellent interpersonal and multidisciplinary project skills.
* Action\-oriented, entrepreneurial, adaptable, and innovative approach to business planning as well as successfully works in collaboration with diverse groups.
* Mission\-driven passion, committed to integrity, positive attitude, and self\-directed.

**PHYSICAL/SENSORY DEMANDS:**

* Office environment, with occasional lifting up to 25 pounds, squatting and full range of motion.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit or stand; use hands to handle or touch; talk and hear.

Job Type: Part\-time

Pay: $63,000\.00 \- $73,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
BE PART OF SOMETHING GREAT
Job Description
The YMCA of Greater Louisville is seeking an experienced, community\-focused leader to serve as Executive Director of a full\-service YMCA branch with approximately $2\.5 million in annual operations  



  

The Executive Director is responsible for the overall leadership and performance of the branch, including financial management, membership and program growth, staff development, fundraising, community partnerships, facility operations, and safety. This position leads a multidisciplinary team and works closely with volunteers, donors, community partners, and the Branch Advisory Board to advance the YMCA’s mission.


Qualifications
* Bachelor’s degree in business, nonprofit management, recreation, public administration, human services, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* At least five years of progressively responsible leadership experience.
* Experience managing a significant operating budget and leading managers or multidisciplinary teams.
* Demonstrated success in financial management, staff development, program or membership growth, and community engagement.
* Strong communication, decision\-making, relationship\-building, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work a flexible schedule, including occasional evenings, weekends, and community events.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* YMCA or nonprofit leadership experience.
* Experience managing an operation with annual revenue of $2 million or more.
* Experience overseeing an indoor aquatic facility.
* Experience with fundraising, donor development, grants, or sponsorships.
* Experience working with a volunteer board.
Essential Functions
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead daily branch operations and implement annual goals aligned with the YMCA’s strategic priorities.
* Develop and manage an annual operating budget of approximately $2\.7 million.
* Monitor revenue, expenses, membership, program participation, staffing, and overall branch performance.
* Recruit, supervise, coach, and develop branch leadership and staff.
* Drive membership growth, retention, engagement, and customer service.
* Ensure high\-quality programs that respond to community needs.
* Provide executive oversight of one indoor swimming pool and aquatics operations.
* Ensure compliance with health, safety, child\-protection, risk\-management, and YMCA standards.
* Oversee facility maintenance, emergency preparedness, and capital improvement needs.
* Lead annual fundraising efforts and cultivate relationships with donors and sponsors. The annual fundraising goal is $80,000
* Build strong partnerships with schools, businesses, nonprofit organizations, government agencies, and community groups.
* Recruit and engage an effective Branch Advisory Board and other volunteers.
* Represent the YMCA throughout the community.

**Why Work for the YMCA?**  

The YMCA of Greater Louisville offers the opportunity to lead a mission\-driven organization, develop staff and volunteers, strengthen community partnerships, and make a meaningful impact through youth development, healthy living, and social responsibility.


The YMCA of Greater Louisville is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.  



Required Certifications
The successful candidate must obtain and maintain required YMCA certifications, including CPR/AED, First Aid, Child Abuse Prevention, and other required leadership and safety training.

jobs.description:
**About Kinect Solar**
======================


Kinect Solar sits at the intersection of two of the most consequential trends of our time: the build\-out of U.S. renewable energy infrastructure and the modernization of industrial logistics. We are a fast\-growing distribution and logistics company serving the renewable energy sector — moving solar modules, trackers, transformers, and battery energy storage systems (BESS) through a national network of warehouse and logistics partners. We are entering our next phase of growth and investing in the systems, processes, leadership, organizational structure, and operational discipline needed to scale effectively. For the right operator, this is a rare opportunity to build the operating system of a profitable, growing business at an inflection point — partnering with strong commercial leaders across two business lines, an experienced CFO, and a CEO committed to building this company the right way.**The Opportunity**
===================


 We are hiring a Chief Operating Officer to build the operating backbone of Kinect Solar, owning operations, the systems and processes that make the company run, and the operating cadence that holds everything together. This leader will quickly assess the business, team, and operating model while supporting continued growth and business performance. The successful candidate will be comfortable "flying and fueling the plane at the same time," balancing day\-to\-day execution with organizational and operational improvements. Partnering closely with the CFO and the Sales Leaders for our two business lines (KIS and KL), the COO provides the operational rigor, commercial discipline, and infrastructure that allow the business to grow faster and more profitably.


The COO will be responsible for developing and maintaining the enterprise operating framework, performance management processes, and systems required to support continued growth. The Sales Leaders drive revenue and customer relationships within their business lines; the COO owns the enterprise operating system within which both businesses run. The role is designed for a builder who leads through influence and structural authority and is energized by enabling the success of others.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Operations Leadership*** Lead the operations organization across warehouse, logistics, inventory, fulfillment, and special projects
* Manage and optimize the contracted warehouse and 3PL network — carrier and partner selection, performance management, and network design
* Direct freight strategy for specialized cargo (transformers, BESS, trackers, modules), including heavy/oversized freight, permitting, hazmat handling for lithium\-ion, and insurance
* Establish and own operational KPIs across logistics, warehouse, inventory, and fulfillment: on\-time delivery, cost per shipment, damage rates, dwell time, inventory accuracy, claims ratio, and carrier performance
* Assess organizational structure, talent, and operational ownership while integrating and scaling warehouse, transportation, logistics, inventory, and fulfillment operations

**Business Development \& Sales Infrastructure*** Build the BD and sales infrastructure that supports both business lines — pipeline management, forecasting, CRM, deal desk, and the cadence that connects commercial activity to capacity and resource planning
* Partner with the Sales Leaders to translate their commercial strategies into repeatable, measurable processes — without owning the customer relationships
* Own pricing, margin management, and deal\-desk discipline as enterprise functions

jobs.title: Chief Operating Officer
jobs.description:
***Open Position: Chief Operating Officer***  

***Instructional Empowerment*** *exists to transform teaching and learning so every student has access to rigorous, engaging instruction that prepares them for success in school and life. We partner with school districts across the country to improve instructional practice, strengthen leadership, and produce measurable gains in student achievement.*  

  

*Our work is driven by a bold purpose; helping schools eliminate achievement gaps and break cycles of generational poverty by improving the quality of Tier 1 instruction.*  

  

*Today we are a mid\-size company with approximately 100 employees serving districts nationwide. Tomorrow, we intend to become the premier partner for instructional transformation in K\-12 education.*  

  

*We're looking for a Chief Operating Officer who wants to help build that future.*  

*This is not a maintenance role.*  

*This is a builder's opportunity.*  

  

*Are you that builder?* **The Opportunity*** *As Chief Operating Officer, you will serve as the CEO's strategic operating partner, translating visions into disciplined execution across the company.*
* *Y**ou will lead the organization's operating rhythm, develop exceptional leaders, build scalable systems, establish three high\-performing business units and ensure every department is aligned around measurable goals.*
* *Success in this role isn't measured by how well you manage operations. It's measured by how effectively you build an organization capable of achieving extraordinary results.*
* *I**f you enjoy building leaders, creating systems that scale, solving complex organizational challenges and holding teams accountable for results, we'd love to meet you.*
**What You'll Build***Over the next several years you will help build** *Three thriving business units with outstanding leadership*
* *Develop a world\-class leadership team capable of scaling a company*
* *Create organizational systems that support sustainable growth*
* *Increase revenue while improving profitability*
* *Build a culture where data drives decisions and execution wins*
* *Free the CEO to focus on vision, innovation, strategic partnerships, acquisitions and long\-term growth.*

**Success Looks Like**
Within your first 24 months you will have:
✓ Successfully established three high\-performing business units.
✓ Recruited and developed exceptional business unit leadership.
✓ Upgraded leadership capability across the company.
✓ Improved organizational execution through disciplined operating rhythms.
✓ Accelerated revenue growth.
✓ Increased operating margins.
✓ Created a leadership culture built on accountability, ownership, and measurable results. **Who You Are**
You're an operator.
But more importantly...
You're a builder.
You love taking organizations with tremendous potential and helping them scale.
You enjoy coaching leaders more than solving problems for them.
You thrive on turning strategy into execution.
You believe clear goals, clear metrics, and clear accountability produce extraordinary results.
You aren't interested in maintaining the status quo.
You want to build something significant. **Qualifications** \-  

***Required**** *10\+ years of progressive executive leadership experience.*
* *Experience leading multiple functional departments.*
* *Demonstrated success scaling a growth\-stage organization.*
* *Proven experience building leaders and leadership teams.*
* *Strong strategic planning and organizational execution skills.*
* *Experience implementing operating systems such as Agile, Lean, OKRs, Scaling Up or similar frameworks.*
* *Exceptional communication and coaching skills.*
* *Strong analytical and data\-driven decision making skills.*
* *Experience in growing professional services and software integration companies.*
 *Preferred*  

Experience in one or more of the following:* *Professional Services*
* *Consulting*
* *Software/SaaS*
* *Technology\-enabled services*
* *Education Services*
* *Multi\-business or multi\-division organization*
* *K\-12 education experience is helpful but not required*

**Why This Role Is Different**
Most COO positions inherit mature organizations.
This one helps build one.  

You'll have the opportunity to shape the company's operating model, develop its leaders, establish its business units, and help create an organization capable of serving thousands of schools and millions of students.  

If you are energized by building organizations, developing leaders, and creating lasting impact, this may be the opportunity you've been looking for. **Our Core Values**
We believe exceptional organizations are built by people who:* *Lead with integrity*
* *Put students first*
* *Value teamwork over ego*
* *Pursue excellence relentlessly*
* *Learn continuously*
* *Hold themselves and others accountable*
* *Believe every child deserves exceptional teaching*
**Location:** This position may begin as a remote/hybrid with future expectations of permanent ability to be in West Palm Beach, Florida office location. **Compensation \& Benefits**
Instructional Empowerment offers a competitive executive compensation package including:* *Competitive base salary*
* *Performance\-based incentive opportunity*
* *Comprehensive health benefits*
* *Paid time off*
* *Retirement benefits*
* *Professional Development*
* *The opportunity to help shape the future of a nationally recognized education company*

jobs.title: Director of Development & Membership
jobs.description:
Lead fundraising, membership, and donor stewardship for a historic campus\-and\-community institution, the University YMCA.
Job Description
The University Y is seeking a mission\-driven professional to take an established development program to the next level. Building upon a strong and successful foundation, the Director of Development \& Membership will work closely with the Executive Director and Board in designing and executing a comprehensive development and membership strategy. Specifically, the Director will be responsible for managing all aspects of the Development program, including the Annual Fund Campaign, developing strategies to cultivate current or new membership, overseeing stewardship practices in the organization, planning fundraising events including the Dump \& Run program, developing planned gifts, and managing and directing major gifts campaigns. Additionally the Director will work with staff leadership to support grant application processes and specific programmatic fundraising initiatives.


Qualifications
* A bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience is required
* Requires a minimum of 3\-5 years of professional experience in development or a closely
  

related field.
* Demonstrated success in fundraising, working with volunteers and project management
  

is required.
* Strong communication skills (written and verbal) are needed, including the ability to speak in public, interact with and motivate donors, community leaders and staff, as well as to write compelling letters/proposals for support.
* An ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced team environment.
* Possess essential computer skills and familiarity with donor databases such as Raiser’s Edge.
* Familiar, knowledgeable and comfortable with social media.
* Experience with grant writing is preferred but not required.
* Some evening, weekend and travel time will be required as necessary
Essential Functions
* Works with key constituencies (volunteer leaders, staff, students, alumni and community partners) in developing and executing Annual Fund campaigns.
* Writes fundraising appeal letters, stewardship and recognition communication, and grant proposals.
* Helps identify major donor prospects and strategies with staff and volunteers to create action plans that will lead to new or increased philanthropic commitments.
* Works with staff leadership to design and produce print, email and social media communication, recognition and training materials; and to develop analog and digital strategies for reaching and engaging supporters.
* Identifies prospects for planned giving and stewards current membership of the Y’s planned giving society, the Heritage Circle
* Investigates and develops new ways to integrate development and program initiatives that make the impact of our work more accessible and connected to our supporters.
* Oversees and coordinates the Annual Dinner \& Auction, Dump and Run® and additional fundraising events as needed.
* Evaluate and assess development activities making adjustments and modifications as needed.
* Maintain and update donor database and constituent records to facilitate good communication and segmentation practices
* Works with the staff and volunteer leadership to appropriately record, reconcile and audit all gifts to the organization; to produce and analyze reports as well as ensure accuracy, quality and process continuity of all development activities; to plan and execute an effective Development budget.
Cause\-Driven Leadership Competencies
* Philanthropy – Values and supports the many facets of philanthropy as an essential component in achieving our mission.
* Relationships – Builds authentic relationships in the service of enhancing individual and team performance to support our work.
* Communication – Listens and expresses self effectively and in a manner that reflects a true understanding of the needs of the audience.
* Influence – Employs influence strategies that engage, inspire, and build commitment to the cause and overall goals.
* Developing Others – Recognizes and acts on the need to continually develop others’ capabilities to attain the highest level of performance possible.
* Project Management – Supports goal attainment by prioritizing activities, assigning responsibilities in accordance with capabilities, monitoring progress, and evaluating impact.
* Quality Results – Demonstrates and fosters a strong commitment to achieving goals in a manner that provides quality experiences.
* Change Capacity – Leads self and others through change by navigating ambiguity appropriately and adapting well to new situations, obstacles, and opportunities.
